thread:
jamie: Hey team, accepted the org invite but I only see public repos and can't clone internal ones. first day oops :sweat_smile:

morgan: welcome! which repo are you trying to hit?

jamie: trying to clone redwood/infra-staging

jamie: git clone returns:
```
Cloning into 'infra-staging'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: repository 'https://github.com/redwood/infra-staging/' not found
```

morgan: hm ok two quick checks: 1) did you accept the invite with the same GitHub account email you used for the org? 2) did you complete SSO/2FA flow when prompted? sometimes the org hides private repos until SSO is complete.

jamie: accepted via the link sent to my personal gmail (used that because work email redirect wasn't set up yet). I see a banner saying "SAML SSO required" when I try to view the repo in the browser.

devops-bot: Provisioning log: user jamie accepted invite at 1719123465, SSO status: pending, team assignment queued.

lina: @jamie if you go to https://github.com/settings/organizations you should see a redwood entry and a button to "Authorize SAML" — click that while logged into the account you accepted with. If you need to move to your work-managed account ping me and I can resend to the work email.

jamie: clicking authorize now... it asked me to enable 2FA first. I enabled TOTP via authenticator. done.

morgan: cool, once you authorize SAML the org should show private repos. if still blocked, let me try a membership sync.

alex: I see the queued team assignment failed because GH username didn't match the invite email. I can run the membership sync for jamie now. running: `orgctl sync-members --user jamie --force`

devops-bot: orgctl: membership sync initiated for jamie at 1719123550, result: success. Teams added: platform, infra-oncall.

morgan: try the clone again

jamie: whoa okay `git clone` worked! I see infra-staging now :tada:

jamie: quick follow-up — can I push to infra-staging or is that gated behind another permission?

alex: you have read + triage by default. I just granted write on infra-staging for your account. `permissions: write` applied.

jamie: confirmed I can push a branch. thanks!! :raised_hands:

lina: welcome aboard! ping if anything else blocks your first-week setup.

jamie: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help.
